purpose: Check high-risk concepts where neutral taxonomy, China curriculum placement, comparison copy, navigation and classroom tasks could imply different meanings or curriculum scope.

checks.issue: The stronger curriculum research record marks negative numbers as not a standalone 2022 China primary requirement and records the scope change to junior secondary. Some later comparison/task wording described Grade 5-6 contextual treatment in a way that could be read as primary curriculum placement.
checks.resolution: Runtime must classify negative-numbers as not_primary_requirement for China primary browse. Search/comparison may still surface it as related content. Any classroom task is an extension/comparison task, not China core content.

checks.issue: Neutral taxonomy places the concept with decimals/percentages while China 2022 places percentage in Statistics and Probability.
checks.resolution: Jurisdiction domain override already sends China curriculum browsing to Statistics and Probability without changing the neutral concept_id.

checks.issue: Neutral concept combines three forms while China curriculum evidence is split across Number and Statistics/Probability.
checks.resolution: China browse may show cross-domain placement; comparison copy explicitly avoids claiming one national three-way conversion standard without direct evidence.

checks.issue: Common Core line plot could be mistranslated or collapsed into line graph.
checks.resolution: Search and terminology rules explicitly prevent line plot from auto-resolving to line-graphs.

checks.issue: China primary circle content reaches circumference/area depth without a direct Common Core Grades 1-6 equivalent.
checks.resolution: Comparison layer shows the nonmatch rather than forcing a US grade.

checks.issue: China/England primary transformation content has no systematic Common Core Grades 1-6 translation strand.
checks.resolution: Comparison and task evidence notes preserve the nonmatch.

checks.issue: China/England primary rotation content has no systematic Common Core Grades 1-6 rotation strand.
checks.resolution: Comparison and task evidence notes preserve the nonmatch.

checks.issue: China third-stage chance content has no formal primary England/Common Core probability strand.
checks.resolution: Comparison, navigation and task layers preserve the framework nonmatch.

checks.issue: China 2022 primary algebra organisation differs from older textbook-style equation progression.
checks.resolution: Use the verified current China curriculum relationship/equality/letter-expression route and do not backfill old standalone equation sequencing as current.
